args.sqlQuery: SELECT * FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(t.trandate,'YYYY') AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(NVL(-tl.netamount,0)) AS gross_bookings FROM transaction t JOIN transactionline tl ON tl.transaction = t.id WHERE t.type = 'SalesOrd' AND tl.mainline = 'F' AND tl.taxline = 'F' AND NVL(tl.itemtype,'x') NOT IN ('ShipItem','TaxItem','TaxGroup') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t.trandate,'YYYY') ORDER BY 1) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1000
args.description: Gross bookings by order year from sales order lines, excluding tax and shipping lines (aggregates only)

open_points: Amounts are tl.netamount summed across subsidiaries with no currency conversion; the manifest requires transaction, subsidiary-base and consolidated bases.
Sign: sales order lines carry negative netamount, so the query negates it. Verified only by the result being positive.
Closed and cancelled lines are included (gross_bookings); net_bookings is not built.
Not tied to a NetSuite report (manifest tie_out.report is to be confirmed).
